verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own v0.3.5 blog lists "structured outputs via llama.cpp or Apple MLX" among the capabilities its local server exposes to apps, which supports constraining output on the serving API. That is the only mention in the pack, and it gives no detail on JSON schema, grammar formats or how requests specify the constraint. missing for 10: documentation of the JSON schema or grammar request parameters, explicit grammar (e.g. GBNF) support, API examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
